lines.text: The LORD tells Aaron to bring his brothers from the tribe of Levi to assist him at the Tent.
Only Aaron and his sons attend to the priesthood for everything concerning the altar and what is inside the veil.
The price to redeem a month-old male is ten shekels, but firstborn oxen, sheep and goats are not redeemed.
The LORD tells Aaron he will have no inheritance in the land, and gives the Levites all the firstfruits.
The LORD tells Moses that the Levites must present a tithe of the tithe to Aaron the priest.
